description: The receiving side's check before settlement. Given the payee's registry id (sid) and, optionally, the payer, amount and purpose, returns accept / decline / hold_request_info / not_ready with reason codes, the fields to request, evidence and a signature. Rule-based, not a model's opinion. Same logic as POST https://oceanalt.com/api/payee/decide.
name: payee_decide
title: Payee-side decision: accept this payment? (free)
